GRADE 9 INTEGRATED SCIENCE — TERM 1 EXAM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Time: 30 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Structure of the atom in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the structure of the atom,
   B. Learners should ignore Structure of the atom completely.
   C. Structure of the atom is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Structure of the atom.

2. About Structure of the atom around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. determine the mass number of elements,
   B. Learners should ignore Structure of the atom completely.
   C. Structure of the atom is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Structure of the atom.

3. About Structure of the atom in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. draw the electron arrangement in atoms using dot or cross diagrams,
   B. Learners should ignore Structure of the atom completely.
   C. Structure of the atom is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Structure of the atom.

5. About Metals and Alloys in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the physical properties of metals,
   B. Learners should ignore Metals and Alloys completely.
   C. Metals and Alloys is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Metals and Alloys.

6. About Metals and Alloys around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the composition of alloys,
   B. Learners should ignore Metals and Alloys completely.
   C. Metals and Alloys is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Metals and Alloys.

7. About Metals and Alloys in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the uses of metals and alloys in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Metals and Alloys completely.
   C. Metals and Alloys is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Metals and Alloys.

9. About Water hardness in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the physical properties of water,
   B. Learners should ignore Water hardness completely.
   C. Water hardness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water hardness.

10. About Water hardness around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. distinguish between hard and soft water in nature,
   B. Learners should ignore Water hardness completely.
   C. Water hardness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water hardness.

11. About Water hardness in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. apply methods of softening hard water in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Water hardness completely.
   C. Water hardness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water hardness.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Structure of the atom in your school compound.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Metals and Alloys in your school compound.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Water hardness in your school compound.
